title: A Light for Every Step
story:
One evening, a father and his daughter were walking along a narrow path back to their cabin.

As darkness settled in, the little girl became afraid because she could no longer see the way.

Her father handed her a small lantern.

It did not light the entire trail ahead, but it clearly illuminated the next few steps.

"Keep walking," her father said. "The light will always show you where to place your next step."

As they continued, the lantern faithfully revealed the path little by little until they safely reached home.

Life often feels uncertain, and we may wish God would show us the entire journey.

Instead, He gives us His Word as a lamp for our feet and a light for our path.

The Bible may not answer every question about tomorrow, but it faithfully provides the wisdom we need for today.

As we trust and obey God's Word, He guides us safely one step at a time.
life_lesson: God's Word is our daily guide. When we follow it faithfully, He leads us safely through every season of life.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for giving me Your Word to guide my life.

Help me to trust Your direction even when I cannot see the whole journey.

Teach me to obey Your truth one step at a time.

May Your Word always be the light that directs my decisions and my path.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you waiting for God to reveal your entire future instead of trusting Him with the next step?

How can you spend more time in God's Word this week?

What decision today needs the guidance of His truth?
verse: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.
